title: Case: Parcel held at depot over a flat number on the label
context: A floor lamp (order TG-952, shipment DL-952) is held at the depot because the driver could not match the label address. Routing control at the carrier owns label address corrections.
initial_request: Any news?? Its been two days. I told you its flat 14. I'm in all day tomorrow.

events.body: DL-952 held, address query. Label reads Flat 4, Corbel House, Wren Lane. Driver reports Flat 4 is occupied by a different name and refused the parcel. We do not change a label on the recipient's word or on a desk's summary of it. Send us the merchant's amendment reference and the address exactly as it now stands on the merchant order record and we will check it against Tallowmere's feed and correct the label. Held items return to sender after 5 working days.
its flat 14 not flat 4. i mistyped at checkout. ive changed it in my account just now. can you get it sent to the right door please
DL-966: label corrected to Flat 41, Corbel Court, Wren Road per merchant amendment AM-966. Released from hold, loaded to route for tomorrow. No further action.

TG-952 order record was amended by the customer through his account today at 10:36. Delivery address on the record is now: Flat 14, Corbel House, Wren Lane. Amendment reference AM-952. Note our carrier feed only pushes an address at label creation, so Plover will not have seen this. We have not contacted the carrier.

acceptable_actions.summary: Send Routing control merchant amendment AM-952 and the amended order address (Flat 14, Corbel House, Wren Lane) and ask them to verify, correct the DL-952 label and confirm release.

must: Sends the request to Routing control at Plover Arc Logistics for DL-952
Quotes merchant amendment reference AM-952 for order TG-952
Gives the address as it stands on the merchant record: Flat 14, Corbel House, Wren Lane
Asks Routing control to confirm the correction and release rather than assuming it
must_not: Say DL-952 has been corrected, released or loaded for delivery (the release in the thread is DL-966)
Give Routing control the DL-966 address (Flat 41, Corbel Court, Wren Road) or reference AM-966
Present the correction as resting only on the recipient's say-so, without the merchant amendment reference
Promise the recipient delivery tomorrow or at any set time
expected.reference_message: DL-952 address correction, as you requested on 2026-04-20. Merchant amendment reference AM-952 on Tallowmere order TG-952. The delivery address on the merchant order record now reads: Flat 14, Corbel House, Wren Lane (label currently shows Flat 4). Tallowmere's Warehouse dispatch confirms the amendment was made on the record on 2026-04-20 and was not pushed through the carrier feed. Please verify against the feed, correct the label and confirm when DL-952 is released from hold. It is on day 2 of 5.

rationale: Routing control named exactly what it needs to correct the label: the merchant amendment reference and the address on the merchant record. Warehouse dispatch supplied both and said it had not told the carrier. The correction and release messages in the thread are about DL-966, a different parcel with a similar address.

review.note: Coordinator emailed Routing control with AM-952 and the record address as keyed; no change to the key.
